label: RELAY POLICY: prescreening choices made by the Relay team. These are NOT protocol requirements; every rule that uses one says so in its reason text. The study team applies the current protocol.

labRecencyDays.why: Labs older than this are 'outdated for prescreening' (unknown/stale) where the registry gives no window of its own.

pdl1NegativeBelowTps.why: CodeBreaK 202 says 'negative for PD-L1 expression' without a cut-off. Relay reads local TPS < 1% as negative; central confirmation is a separate at-screening row.

egfrSensitizing.why: Lung-MAP S1900G says 'sensitizing EGFR mutation' without a list.

alterations.basis: Working table compiled by the Relay team from general knowledge of UK (NICE/MHRA) practice as of the date above. NOT verified against NICE or MHRA during the build. Any 'uncertain' cell makes the row needs_review; verify before clinical use.

columns.ukFirstLine: approved | uncertain | no — targeted therapy approved in the UK as first-line treatment for this alteration
columns.ukAnyLine: approved | uncertain | no — any approved targeted treatment for this alteration in the UK, any line
columns.driver: yes | uncertain | no — counts as a known oncogenic driver
